# abit v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

Use `:atomics` as a bit array or as an array of N-bit counters.

## Modules

- [Abit](https://abit.hexdocs.pm/Abit.md): Abit lets you use `:atomics` as a bit array or as an array of N-bit counters.
- [Abit.Atomics](https://abit.hexdocs.pm/Abit.Atomics.md): This module provides utility functions for working with Erlang's :atomics.

- [Abit.Bitmask](https://abit.hexdocs.pm/Abit.Bitmask.md): Functions for working with bits & integer bitmasks.

- [Abit.Counter](https://abit.hexdocs.pm/Abit.Counter.md): Use `:atomics` as an array of counters with N bits per counter.
An `:atomics` is an array of 64 bit integers so the possible counters are below
